user_saw: An agent was prompted to use the diffs tool even in sessions where it could not call it.
summary: The fix attaches diffs guidance to its tool registration and renders it only when the tool is callable.
reasoning: The fix removes a before_prompt_build hook that unconditionally returned DIFFS_AGENT_GUIDANCE, and local blame puts that hook before the shallow boundary. The offline full-history path log stopped at a missing object, so I could not verify whether the hook shipped with the mismatch or whether a later usage exposed it.
